item.title: E01: The Capital Stack: Who's Actually Lending in Late 2026
item.description: The capital stack, explained layer by layer on one Jersey City deal, plus who is writing the checks in late 2026, what the Fed's September hike means for floating-rate borrowers, and why rescue capital is having its moment.
